## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
Extend `Document`, `DocumentProcessor`, `IngestWorker`, and `IngestChunkWorker` through `DocumentGeneration` so content replacement and generation identity are coherent. Check generation at final chunk insertion in every ingestion path. Preserve stable document IDs and manual document assignments; cascade old chunk assignments.
Files: New lib/zaq/ingestion/document_generation.ex; document.ex, chunk.ex, document_processor.ex, ingest_worker.ex, ingest_chunk_worker.ex, ingest_chunk_job.ex.

## Tests to add before implementation
full re-ingestion, same-content re-ingestion, concurrent runs, old embedding completion, targeted retries, obsolete queued jobs, source identity, and conversion failure before replacement. External embedding/conversion boundaries may be stubbed; transactions remain real. Document migration/deployment behavior and lifecycle invariants.
Immediate unit/integration/property/LiveView tests apply. New feature E2E waits for human UX approval; changing existing test behavior requires explicit approval.

## Branches/paths validated
full re-ingestion, same-content re-ingestion, concurrent runs, old embedding completion, targeted retries, obsolete queued jobs, source identity, and conversion failure before replacement. External embedding/conversion boundaries may be stubbed; transactions remain real. Document migration/deployment behavior and lifecycle invariants.
Preserve manual document inclusion/exclusion across re-ingestion; replace all chunk assignments. Missing Decision configuration skips automatic labeling.

## Mocking plan
Use real Repo, permissions, domain contexts, Action validation and dispatch wherever practical. Control only external model/embedding/conversion/provider HTTP and genuine nondeterministic boundaries. Runtime opts use Zaq.Config.get/4. No broad global mocks or sleep-based coordination. Review/approval-only steps need no mocks.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
docs/services/ingestion.md and affected module docs; docs/architecture.md for approved cross-role/generation boundaries. Keep this Page's final specification aligned; progress remains in Beadwork.

## Action reuse assessment
Extend existing Document.upsert, async scheduling and synchronous process_and_store_chunks_report via a local generation coordinator. Inputs canonical source/content/expected generation; stable document output or stale/conflict error; lock/changeset transactions, UUID and embedding boundary. Not a public Action because it is ingestion transaction ownership. Verify both ingestion paths, old writers, retries and deployment jobs.

## Validation and prerequisites
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle, docs/testing-approach.md and docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md. All cross-service BO calls use NodeRouter.dispatch/1 and explicit Event action. No commit/push/merge authorized. Dependencies follow the three-PR sequence in the parent issue; only task 1 is initially ready.
## Feature E2E and approval tracking
Human UX: zaq-kw0.15; consolidated feature E2E: zaq-kw0.16; contract gate: zaq-kw0.1; review/coverage: zaq-kw0.17; final validation: zaq-kw0.18.

Current scope: category labeling only. Independent boolean decisions permit multiple labels. Manual add/remove overrides automation; reset releases control. No free-text extraction or summarization.
## PR ownership and completion
PR 2. PR 2 requires merged/approved PR 1. Test exactly one automatic chunk label across multiple new chunks, no automatic labels, absent/removed model, shared processor isolation, manual precedence, reset activation and stale commit guards. No extraction/summarization processors.
Immediate unit/integration/LiveView tests and owning documentation ship in this PR. Completion gate: zaq-kw0.20. Apply review, coverage and final validation separately per PR. Persistent feature E2E zaq-kw0.16 remains blocked by UX zaq-kw0.15; earlier PRs explicitly report deferred E2E.
